topic: Running Kimi K3 on MI355X at Better Performance per Dollar Than B300
headline: Kimi K3 Dominates MI355X
caption: As a full stack engineer, I'm always on the lookout for hardware that offers the best bang for the buck. Seeing Kimi K3 run on MI355X deliver better performance per dollar than the B300 is exciting. It means we can scale more cost-effectively without sacrificing speed. This kind of hardware improvement opens doors for smarter infrastructure choices and faster development cycles. Keep an eye on these trends, as they can influence how we build and deploy applications in the future 🚀. Have you tried similar setups?
